doc.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
doc.interviewee: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack")

title: Buddy Bolden and news of Punch Miller
summary: Allen reports that Punch Miller is living in New Orleans with his niece and playing. Mary sends their love.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Do you remember a band, a cornet player called Buddy Bolden? Oh, yes, sure, sure.
He died soon. Yes, he's been dead. He told me he was living with his sister now. He sent me there to the restaurant.

Yes, Punch is, right now he's actually living with his niece, his sister's daughter in New Orleans. His sister's out in the country. Uh-huh. But he looks quite well and he still plays. You've seen him? Yes. Oh, yes, I've seen him down to see me about two weeks ago.
Two weeks ago last Saturday, I guess.
Oh, yes, I lived there now.
Well, you give our love to Punch and tell him we got this letter.
All right, maybe I'll be able to play this record for him too.
All right. He said, listen there, Miss Mary, Mr. Mike. That sure is Miss Mary.
